_meta.description: Stage 3 (Credentialized) for the universal Anaplan product Sales journey template. Practice-and-credential stage built around AI-graded mock pitches plus a senior-reviewer credential pitch. Slots into the larger Sales template at stages[2].
structural_alignment_with_delivery: Same shape as Delivery Stage 3: progression of 3 graded labs followed by a credential gate, plus a mandatory Academy course covering field patterns
Replaces Delivery's instructor-led workshop sessions with self-paced AI-graded mock pitches — sellers' time is at a premium and AI grading scales without instructor capacity bottlenecks
Replaces Delivery's tooling-verified labs with AI-graded mock pitches (mocks evaluated against a structured rubric)
Replaces Delivery's Top-10-Extensions Academy course with Top-10-Field-Selling-Patterns — analogous purpose: field-experience content that mocks cannot teach
Phase remains 'learning' — Stage 3 sharpens skill in a controlled environment; Stage 4 is the first true 'doing' stage with real customers

credentialing_mechanism.ai_mock_pitch_agent: Each of the 3 mock-pitch labs uses an AI agent (planned capability, depends on P10 tooling spec) playing the prospect role. Mocks are recorded; AI grades the seller's performance against a structured rubric (discovery completeness, value-clarity, objection handling, competitive positioning) and produces feedback. Pass criteria: rubric threshold per mock. Failed mocks can be retried.
credentialing_mechanism.senior_reviewer_credential_pitch: After all 3 AI-graded mocks pass, the seller delivers a final end-to-end credential pitch — recorded asynchronously or live to a senior reviewer (sales coach, senior seller, PSM). Reviewer scores against a structured rubric and attests pass/fail. This is the official Stage 3 credential.
credentialing_mechanism.ai_agent_fallback: If the AI mock-pitch agent is not available at launch, fallback is human-panel-graded mocks. Op Cmte / P10 will lock the launch-readiness call.

_meta.boundary_with_stage_4: End of Stage 3: seller has demonstrated discovery, value pitch, objection handling, and competitive positioning fluency in a controlled mock environment, and has been exposed to the field's most common selling patterns for {{PRODUCT_NAME}}. They have NOT yet faced a real customer. Stage 4 is the progressive 3-level real-engagement model (shadow → co-lead → solo with post-engagement review).
open_items_parked_for_later: AI mock-pitch agent — whether to build per-product agents or one general agent with product-specific scenarios. P10 tooling spec.
Mock pitch rubric design — per-mock rubrics need to be authored, not just per-product scenarios. Op Cmte deliverable.
Senior reviewer pool — sourcing, training, and scheduling for the credential pitch reviewers. Operational policy.
Failed-mock retry policy — unlimited retries vs cooldown vs escalation after N failures. Operational policy.
Async vs live credential pitch — default async (recording reviewed by senior); live is alternative. Operational policy.
Per-product Top-10-Field-Selling-Patterns Academy course — must be authored per product.

name: Credentialized
description: Seller demonstrates {{PRODUCT_NAME}} selling fluency by completing three AI-graded mock pitches (discovery, value pitch + objection handling, competitive positioning) and a senior-reviewer-graded credential pitch. Closes with the Top 10 Field Selling Patterns Academy course covering the most common field selling situations for {{PRODUCT_NAME}}.

tasks._fixed: task definition fixed; mock scenario and rubric specifics variable per product
tasks.title: {{PRODUCT_NAME}} mock pitch — discovery & qualification
tasks.description: AI-graded mock pitch focused on discovery and qualification. The AI agent plays a prospect at initial-interest stage; the seller runs a discovery conversation, surfaces business pain, qualifies the opportunity using the framework from Stage 2, and proposes a logical next step. AI grades against a structured rubric and provides feedback.
tasks.asset: {{PRODUCT_NAME}} Mock Pitch — Discovery & Qualification (AI scenario + rubric)
tasks.estimated_effort: 45-60 min (mock + feedback review; allow time for retry if needed)
tasks._completion_mechanism_note: AI evaluates against a structured rubric (e.g., discovery breadth, qualification framework correctness, business-pain articulation). Seller passes when rubric threshold is met.

tasks._fixed: task definition fixed; mock scenario and rubric specifics variable per product
tasks.title: {{PRODUCT_NAME}} mock pitch — value pitch & objection handling
tasks.description: AI-graded mock pitch focused on delivering a tailored value pitch and handling objections. The AI agent plays a prospect with stated needs (pre-discovered scenario); the seller delivers a value pitch keyed to those needs, weaves in proof points and client references, and responds to a series of escalating objections. AI grades against a structured rubric and provides feedback.
tasks.asset: {{PRODUCT_NAME}} Mock Pitch — Value Pitch & Objection Handling (AI scenario + rubric)
tasks.estimated_effort: 45-60 min (mock + feedback review; allow time for retry if needed)

tasks.title: {{PRODUCT_NAME}} mock pitch — competitive positioning
tasks.description: AI-graded mock pitch focused on competitive positioning. The AI agent plays a prospect actively evaluating Anaplan against a named competitor (drawn from the Stage 2 battlecards); the seller defends Anaplan's positioning, surfaces differentiators, and counters competitor talking points. AI grades against a structured rubric and provides feedback.
tasks.asset: {{PRODUCT_NAME}} Mock Pitch — Competitive Positioning (AI scenario + rubric)
tasks.estimated_effort: 45-60 min (mock + feedback review; allow time for retry if needed)

tasks._fixed: task definition fixed; credential scenario and rubric specifics variable per product
tasks.title: {{PRODUCT_NAME}} credential pitch — senior-reviewer-graded end-to-end
tasks.description: End-to-end credential pitch covering discovery, value pitch, objection handling, competitive positioning, and proposed next steps — delivered against a holistic prospect scenario. Default mode is asynchronous recorded pitch reviewed by a senior reviewer (sales coach / senior seller / PSM); live mode is also acceptable. Reviewer scores against a structured rubric and attests pass/fail. This is the official Stage 3 credential gate.
tasks.asset: {{PRODUCT_NAME}} Credential Pitch — scenario + rubric + reviewer attestation form
tasks._completion_mechanism_note: Senior reviewer attestation against rubric. PSM coordinates reviewer assignment.

tasks._fixed: task definition fixed; course content variable per product
tasks.title: {{PRODUCT_NAME}} Top 10 Field Selling Patterns Academy course
tasks.description: Mandatory Academy course authored by the {{PRODUCT_NAME}} CoE / sales enablement team covering the 10 selling patterns most commonly seen in the field for {{PRODUCT_NAME}} — common deal-stage transitions, late-stage objections, ROI-conversation patterns, multi-stakeholder selling, and recurring tactical situations. Field-experience content the participant cannot get from mocks. Includes a completion quiz.
tasks._placement_note: Required to be completed AFTER the credential pitch (credential-pitch pass unlocks the course).
